summary: Attribute::unescape_value passes a resolver returning None, causing all five predefined XML entities, including &, to produce EscapeError::UnrecognizedEntity. The fix supplies resolve_predefined_entity so these references decode correctly. The verbatim reversal is identifiable, but no detecting upstream test exists at this revision: the fix adds no tests, and the only external caller of unescape_value is a fuzz target that tolerates errors. Existing escape tests exercise a different entry point. Blocked by the absence of a detecting upstream test; no tests were run.
